counterfactual_missing_items: No histologic confirmation of smooth-muscle origin (e.g., SMA/desmin) is provided.
No stigmata of neurofibromatosis or nerve-sheath features are described.
No soft, compressible, or vascular features are described to support hemangioma.
decisive_items: well‐circumscribed, oval, covered by regular skin, firm, gray‐white
response.rationale: R2 best integrates the firm, fibrotic, well-circumscribed, encapsulated, gray-white polypoid anal mass, which is most consistent with leiomyoma. R3 shares the fibrotic and gross appearance but lacks the encapsulation and is less specific for an anal canal spindle-cell tumor. R4 lacks the firm/fibrotic consistency, and R1 is contradicted by the firm non-bleeding lesion. C1 is only an anatomy-tagged restatement of R2 with weak location-only spans.

rejected.why: Hemangioma is contradicted by the firm/fibrotic consistency and absence of bleeding or discharge; no vascular features are present.
Neurofibroma lacks support from the firm/fibrotic consistency and would require nerve-sheath features or neurofibromatosis stigmata; encapsulation alone is nonspecific.
Append-only completion of R2; its raw spans only indicate anal location and add no independent diagnostic evidence beyond R2.
